lessonTitleEnglish: The tangent to a circle — Practice
source: По темам армянских учебников математики для 8 класса

stages.headline: Сколько касательных можно провести из точки, лежащей вне окружности?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many tangents from an outside point?
stages.problemText: How many tangents from an outside point?

stages.headline: Сколько касательных можно провести через точку на окружности?
stages.headlineEnglish: Tangents through a point on the circle?
stages.problemText: Tangents through a point on the circle?

stages.headline: Можно ли провести касательную из точки внутри окружности?
stages.headlineEnglish: Can a tangent be drawn from a point inside the circle?
stages.problemText: Can a tangent be drawn from a point inside the circle?

stages.headline: ∠AOB = 140° (A, B — точки касания). Угол между касательными?
stages.headlineEnglish: ∠AOB = 140° (A, B contact points). Angle between the tangents?
stages.problemText: ∠AOB = 140° (A, B contact points). Angle between the tangents?
